intro: This errand serves as a test of responsibility for an initiate shaman in the Valley of Trials. If an acolyte misplaces the consecrated Earth Sapta before communing with the spirits of the land, Canaga Earthcaller provides a replacement with a stern reminder to treat sacred draughts with care.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I give you one in good faith. You already proved yourself once, but me tinkin' you should be more careful in the future.
